streaming.liveText: # NoteStore Implementation Specification## Project ContextThis is a greenfield implementation for the overlay-web-benchmark project. The project structure has been explored:- Project root: Contains package.json, tsconfig.json, and .opencorvus/ configuration- src directory: Currently empty, ready for new TypeScript files- TypeScript config: ES2022 target, strict mode enabled, module resolution set to "Bundler"- Runtime: Bun runtime with bun:test framework available## Technical Design### File: src/note-store.tsThis file will export:1. Note Interface: A TypeScript interface defining the note structure:      export interface Note {     id: string;     title: string;     done: boolean;     created_at: number;   }   2. NoteStore Class: An in-memory store backed by Map<string, Note>:   - Private field: private notes = new Map<string, Note>()   - create(title: string): Note - Creates a new note with trimmed title, validates non-empty input, generates UUID via crypto.randomUUID(), sets done=false and created_at=Date.now()   - get(id: string): Note | undefined - Retrieves a note by ID   - list(): Note[] - Returns all notes sorted by created_at ascending   - toggle(id: string): Note | undefined - Flips the done boolean and returns updated note   - remove(id: string): boolean - Deletes the note and returns success status### File: src/note-store.test.tsTest file using bun:test framework with the following test cases:1. create returns a complete Note: Verify that create() returns an object with all required fields (id, title, done=false, created_at as timestamp)2. empty title throws: Verify that create('') and create('   ') throw an error3. list preserves creation order: Create multiple notes and verify list() returns them sorted by created_at ascending4. toggle flips done: Create a note, toggle it twice, verify done flips from false→true→false5. remove deletes successfully: Create a note, remove it, verify get() returns undefined## Implementation Constraints- No external dependencies: Use only built-in crypto.randomUUID() for UUID generation- In-memory only: No persistence layer required- Strict TypeScript: All code must compile with strict mode enabled- bun:test syntax: Use describe, it, expect from bun:test## Acceptance Criteria1. Both files exist at the specified paths2. bun test ./src/note-store.test.ts executes successfully with all tests passing3. TypeScript compilation succeeds with no errors4. All five test cases are implemented and passing5. Code includes appropriate comments per project preferences## Out-of-Scope- Database persistence or serialization- REST API or HTTP endpoints- Frontend UI components- Additional CRUD operations (update title, bulk operations)- README documentation (per task constraints - only modify the two specified files)
